title: Constant Step Sizes for Muon-Type Spectral Optimizers on Strongly Convex Quadratics
abstract: arXiv:2610.27747v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Muon and related optimizers update a weight matrix with a spectrally transformed gradient. In this work, we study such spectral optimizers with a constant step size on strongly convex matrix quadratics, which isolate the effect of the update from the confounds of nonconvexity, noise, and step size schedules. We analyze an update using two quantities: the gain, which is the factor by which it amplifies the gradient along each singular direction, and the length, which is the norm of the update. These two quantities place the popular spectral updates in three regimes with different behavior: (i) with a bounded gain, the iterates behave like preconditioned gradient descent and converge for step sizes set by the largest curvature; (ii) with an unbounded gain but a vanishing length, they still converge, with the admissible step sizes set by the total curvature instead; and (iii) with a non-vanishing length, they do not converge for almost ever

translated_title: 强凸二次型问题上Muon类谱优化器的常数步长分析
translated_abstract: Muon及相关优化器通过谱变换后的梯度来更新权重矩阵。在这项工作中，我们研究了此类谱优化器在强凸矩阵二次型问题上使用常数步长的表现，该设置将更新本身的效果与非凸性、噪声和步长调度等干扰因素隔离开来。我们通过两个量来分析这类更新：增益，即更新沿每个奇异方向放大梯度的倍数；以及长度，即更新本身的范数。这两个量将流行的谱更新划分为三种具有不同行为特性的机制：(i) 当增益有界时，迭代过程类似于预条件梯度下降，且在由最大曲率所决定的步长下收敛；(ii) 当增益无界但长度趋于消失时，迭代仍然收敛，但可容许的步长由总曲率决定；(iii) 当长度不趋于消失时，迭代在几乎任何步长下都不收敛。
tldr: 本文通过增益和长度两个关键量，将Muon类谱优化器在强凸二次问题上的行为划分为三种机制，揭示了增益有界时按最大曲率设定步长可收敛、增益无界但长度消失时按总曲率设定步长可收敛、而长度非消失时几乎不收敛的收敛规律。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes three regimes of Muon-type spectral optimizers on strongly convex quadratics via gain and length: bounded gain converges with step sizes set by the largest curvature, unbounded gain with vanishing length converges with step sizes set by the total curvature, while non-vanishing length fails to converge for almost all step sizes.
